tools.name: lookup_error_code
tools.description: Explains Microsoft authentication error codes from Microsoft's official tables: Entra ID sign-in errors (AADSTS50126, or the bare 50126), Windows NTSTATUS codes as logged in events 4625/4776 (0xC000006A, C000006A, or decimal 3221225578 / -1073741718), Kerberos failure codes from events 4768/4769/477

tools.name: check_ip_blocklists
tools.description: Checks IPv4 addresses against 12 free public blocklists (IPsum, FireHOL levels 1-3, Spamhaus DROP, blocklist.de, CINS Army, GreenSnow, DShield, ET compromised, Tor exits), the same lists as logtriage.app's IP blocklist checker. Accepts a list of addresses or any text containing them (log lines, CSV)

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_error_code" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Explains Microsoft authentication error codes from Microsoft's official tables: Entra ID sign-in errors (AADSTS50126, or the bare 50126), Windows NTSTATUS codes as logged in events 4625/4776 (0xC000006A, C000006A, or decimal 3221225578 / -1073741718), Kerberos failure codes from events 4768/4769/477" → after: "Explains Microsoft authentication error codes from Microsoft's official tables: Entra ID sign-in errors (AADSTS50126, or the bare 50126), Windows NTSTATUS codes as logged in events 4625/4776 (0xC000006A, C000006A, or decimal 3221225578 / -1073741718), Kerberos failure codes from events 4768/4769/477"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
